# ADR-3249: AWS security_groups: 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3389 for security group 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Open RDP is mass-scanned.

## Decision

Security groups SHALL NOT allow 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3389 for security group 1 (AWS-security_groups-1).

## Consequences

Use SSM or VPN-sourced CIDRs.
